query: What should I know before booking hotels through VoyageFlow?
answer_markdown: Before booking hotels through VoyageFlow, it is strongly recommended to verify several details directly on the partner platform [booking-policies::003]. You should confirm the current price, as VoyageFlow does not display live prices [booking-policies::003]. It's also important to check the cancellation policy and refund window [booking-policies::003], as well as the room type, bed configuration, and included amenities [booking-policies::003]. Always verify the total cost, including taxes, fees, and resort charges [booking-policies::003]. VoyageFlow advises users to verify travel information before booking, including current pricing and availability on the partner platform, and cancellation and refund policies specific to the booking [voyageflow-overview::004]. Pricing, availability, and policies can change without notice, and users are responsible for confirming all details before payment [voyageflow-overview::004]. For example, hotel rates in central Tokyo can be 30–50% higher during sakura week, and final pricing and availability must be confirmed on partner platforms [tokyo-spring-guide::004].
